liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **You Don't Love Me** (1 review): Reviewer calls this version a lost gem, sandwiched between Schoolgirl, and wonders why such songs were dropped from later repertoire [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **You Don't Love Me**: rare: 4 archived performances [12]

## The recordings

- **gd66-xx-xx.sbd.jools.19514.19529.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 3 songs; 20 min; rated 4.1/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer recommends using EQ during playback to improve the sound of this recording [9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer suspects the August 1st, 1966 date was a guess based on playing style, not documented [3]
- Based on another listener's research, reviewer thinks the recording most likely comes from late April 1966 [5]
- If from a Longshoreman's Hall run, it could be the January Trips Festival or the April festival; April 22 is guessed [10]
- Reviewer hears Pigpen drawing on Junior Wells' album Hoodoo Man Blues (Delmark, 1965), which has both songs in similar arrangements [8]
- A better-quality copy of this snippet circulates in the Mystery Reels compilation [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd66-xx-xx.sbd.jools.19514.19529.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Julian (Jools) Elliott; source: Soundboard [1]
